inputs.prompt: A concept artist sketchbook page of prop exploration for a dark fantasy video game: twelve rough concept sketches of a floor circle that a floating alien sorceress hovers over, a rune circle and an astral loom with eight marks for her eight powers, laid out in a grid of four columns and three rows on white paper, each sketch numbered with a big hand written number from 1 to 12. Loose confident pencil lines with grey marker shading and a quick wash of plum, night blue and pale astral violet outlines. Every sketch shows the whole object in a three quarter view standing on bare sand, each a genuinely different idea, all made by one alien civilisation from pearly opalescent scaled shell, plum cloth printed with a starfield, rose gold trims and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Every one is a circle on the ground with eight marks around it. No crystal blades, no loose planks. The twelve ideas: 1 a disc of plum starfield cloth pegged flat on the sand with eight glyphs around its rim. 2 a ring of eight standing stones of dark glass, each with a lit glyph. 3 an orrery of eight small astral spheres orbiting over a floor disc. 4 a loom of eight threads of light running from the centre to eight pegs in a circle. 5 a sundial circle cut into eight segments with a shadow pointer. 6 eight floating mirrors in a ring, all facing in. 7 a mandala of light drawn in the sand with eight petals. 8 a round pool of liquid night sky with eight glyph pads floating on it. 9 a rose gold compass rose inlaid in a dark disc, its eight points each a power. 10 a ring of eight lanterns of astral light standing on thin stems. 11 eight thin concentric rings turning at different speeds just above the ground. 12 a dark disc with an eight armed star of astral ribbons floating over it. Short hand written notes and arrows beside some sketches. Clean white paper, no frame, no other text.
